question: Two materials, A and B, have relative magnetic permeabilities $\mu_r$ of 0.9998 and 1.0002, respectively. Distinguish between the two materials with reason.

options.A: Material A is paramagnetic and attracted to magnets; Material B is diamagnetic and repelled.
options.B: Material A is diamagnetic and repelled by magnets; Material B is paramagnetic and attracted.
options.C: Material A is ferromagnetic and strongly attracted; Material B is paramagnetic and weakly attracted.
